title.narrative: 2476 children improved their reading skill from 64% to 81% as the result of UNICEF supported programme. Additionally, 1849 disadvantaged children benefited from enhanced, inclusive, and safe learning environments through upgraded indoor and outdoor facilities. Evidence based policy making was furthjer supported through the studies on critical topics.
